coverage_issues: qwen model: API errors prevented review of PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO (most critical files)
openrouter model: LLM error prevented review of .nvchecker.toml
learnings: API reliability is critical: models should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms when API calls fail, especially for critical files like PKGBUILD
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to tool errors' and 'inconclusive due to security concerns' in verdict reporting
When one model completes a full audit successfully while others fail due to API errors, the successful audit should carry more weight in the final verdict
Consider implementing a minimum coverage threshold: if critical files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .install) cannot be reviewed, the audit should be marked as failed rather than inconclusive
